title: Stack trace to search query
role: Student developers who paste errors into search engines, forums and chats
saves: Cutting frames, folders, line numbers and addresses out of a stack trace before searching or posting it
summary: Type =traceq and paste a stack trace. Copy the exception lines, without your folders, line numbers or memory addresses.

tests.name: python traceback: keeps the exception, drops your folders
tests.input:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/Users/demo-student/projects/app/main.py", line 12, in <module>
    load("/Users/demo-student/projects/data.csv")
  File "/Users/demo-student/projects/app/io.py", line 4, in load
    with open(path) as f:
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/Users/demo-student/projects/data.csv'
tests.expect: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'data.csv'
